verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source realtime platform with a cloud offering, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented setting, flag, or policy for disabling LiveKit's own telemetry or usage tracking. The 'telemetry' mentions refer to data tracks for streaming application telemetry, a different feature, and the option to self-host is a deployment choice rather than an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
